figurative_meaning_en: To blurt out or accidentally reveal something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অজান্তেই রহস্যটা মুখের কথা খসিয়ে ফেলল।
এই কথা মুখের কথা খসানো যাবে না, ভেবে বলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He accidentally blurted out the secret.
Don't let that slip from your mouth; think before you speak.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on careful speech in Bengali society to avoid unintended disclosures.
